profile.headline: Software Engineering | Software Product Leadership | Offensive Security
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer and Product Lead with nearly 10 years of professional software development experience using modern C++ including 5 years in a technical leadership role.

Currently, I am the Software Product Lead for a cross-platform, customer-facing data center modeling GUI application (Qt/C++17) where developers are distributed across the U.S.. I continuously strive to develop and deploy the highest quality software products possible, proving their functionality and performance with automated testing, and fostering a positive and productive remote/hybrid development team atmosphere.

Previous projects to which I have contributed include working on a System Monitoring GUI application with a massive codebase (Qt/C++/Go), Red Team automated exploitation pipeline (Python/Spotify's Luigi) with multithreaded server (Python), and a multithreaded, configurable Red Team network tool complete with configurable modules (C++11/protobuf/libpcap) for Link and Network Layer data communication and packet manipulation.

Earned a B.S. in Computer Science with an emphasis in Cyber Security from California State University, Fullerton.  Aspire to pursue an M.S. in Computer Science with an emphasis in AI, Neural Networks, and Machine Learning.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Product lead for cross-platform hardware system modeling GUI Application written in C++/Qt. Responsible for software feature design, implementation/bug fixes, and sprint/task planning for nine other developers who work on this product. Also responsible for working with end-users to add new features and provide product support, as well working with project managers to provide a plan to complete requested features/bug fixes within provided budget.

positions.description: Brain Computer Interface Research with Dr. Kiran George. Collaborated with Electrical and Mechanical Engineering students to design and implemenet a low cost, non-invasive, Brain-Computer Interface.
